US Administration Seeks Supreme Court Reversal on Mail-In Voting

The Trump administration has asked the U.S. Supreme Court to reinstate a previous order that would restrict mail-in voting. This action comes ahead of the upcoming U.S. midterm elections. The administration seeks to overturn a lower court ruling that had allowed broader access to mail-in ballots.
